commit_message: Implement ADR0126 production Timeline runtime composition
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR0126 first-release completion with the production runtime composition layer. Timeline now composes through the existing Animation, Transform, Camera, Audio, and VFX owners instead of a preview-only runtime, and the shared runtime-system registration is used by both Editor Play and packaged Player.

This request intentionally leaves the PR Draft while the follow-up runtime contract corrections, Project Rust surface, Sequencer authoring workspace, and final Windows/Visual Validation are applied.
